newsitem.title: USA: U.S. barges lightly quoted on call session.
newsitem.headline: U.S. barges lightly quoted on call session.

text.p: U.S. barge rates were lightly quoted Wednesday on the St. Louis Merchants Exchange call session. No barges traded versus no trades Tuesday.
- One barge, Illinois (Hennipen), this week, bid 130 percent of tariff, offered 140 - no comparison on either value.
- One barge, Illinios (Spring Valley), this week, bid 130 percent, offered 140 percent - no comparison on either value.
- One barge, Mississippi (Grand Tower), this week, bid 100 percent - no comparison, no offer.
- Two barges, Illinois, next week, bid 130 percent, offered 137-1/2 - no comparison on either value.
- Two barges, Ohio (Jefferson-Cincinnati), next week, bid 110 percent - no comparison, no offer.
- Two barges, Mississippi (St Louis), next week, no bid, offered 105 percent - no comparison.
- One barge, Ohio (Cincinnati), on station, no bid, offered 110 percent - no compariosn.
- Two barges, Illinois, week of December 22, bid 135 per cent - no comparison, no offer.
